intent: Specify the public API of `scrunch::binary_search`: `binary_search_by<F: FnMut(usize) -> Ordering>(first, last, search) -> usize` and `partition_by<F: FnMut(usize) -> bool>(first, last, search) -> usize`. Both are generic over the closure: in Lean they take an explicit closure-instance record (`core.ops.function.FnMut F Std.Usize core.cmp.Ordering`, resp. `core.ops.function.FnMut F Std.Usize Bool`, with fields `FnOnceInst := { call_once := … }` and `call_mut : F → Std.Usize → RustM (Out × F)`), then `first last : Std.Usize` and the closure state `search : F`. Instantiate them with closure types of your own (any Lean type `F` and `call_mut` you define in your file).
